integrity: The finite maximum is proved by complement reduction, exact classification of one-, two-, and three-frequency supports, exact cyclotomic identities, and rational root isolation. The 127-subset replay is corroborative and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the unrestricted \(p=1\) point-concentration constant on \(\mathbb Z_7\). It does not determine arbitrary prime moduli or the uniform asymptotic constant. An older unindexed modulus-seven table remains a literature risk.
title: Exact \(L^1\) idempotent concentration on \(\mathbb Z_7\)
